board: Seeed Studio Grove - I2C High Accuracy Temp&Humi Sensor (SHT35) (101020592)
reason: Modelled from the Sensirion SHT3x-DIS datasheet (cmd 0x2400, wait 15.5 ms, 6-byte reply with CRC-8 0x31/0xFF, T=-45+175*S/65535, RH=100*S/65535) at address 0x45 (Seeed board's ADDR jumper has a default trace to VCC); Grove pin order SCL,SDA,VCC,GND from Seeed's Eagle board file, marked cabled because the socket is 2 mm Grove. Part check printed PASS on ESP32 and Pico (sim test T=33.5C H=38%, PCB DRC clean).
